viewAttribution.interpretation: Repeated empty GUI view lifecycle approaches a plateau near 84 MiB after hidden windows. This distinguishes post-use resident from cold idle; allocation liveness not yet attributed, no leak or reclaim claim.

failedAllocatorObserverAttempts.reason: Sandbox prevented physical X11 display connection; app never reached initialization or workload. Retained resident/observer logs; retry using the host session permission.

Whole-tree xwininfo failed on a window destroyed during traversal. Saved partial samples/cold allocator counters. Replaced view observer enumeration with EWMH client IDs and existing PID ownership checks; not an application failure.

Buffered stderr readline prefetched the stop-stage marker, so select did not wake to resume the probe. Aggregate before-trim counters saved; observer now uses an unbuffered stderr pipe. Temporary production source was already restored.

viewAllocatorAttribution.interpretation: Empty-view retained heap is predominantly live allocation. At first hidden idle allocated arena bytes 15612944, free 1364976; malloc_trim reduced arena by 126976 only. No production trimming change justified by this view workload. Capture/drained allocator attribution remains separate.
